title: Sokoban
author: sen-ltd
license_scope: The upstream MIT license is retained. The six bundled mini-levels are identified by the upstream README as original. No upstream screenshot, font, sound or runtime dependency is used in the Denny Games game adapter.
host_adaptations: Loads only the pure upstream Sokoban rules, solver and six level definitions; the upstream DOM shell, Vite build, screenshot and dev dependencies are not executed.
Adds a Denny Games lifecycle adapter with pause/resume/restart, accessible keyboard, gamepad and touch movement, undo, level selection and reduced-motion-aware solver playback.
Translates the visible game UI and messages into English and Korean.
Stores completed level IDs in the Denny Games browser save; a partially played level restarts after reload.
Preserves the full pinned upstream snapshot and checks every file hash before publishing corresponding source and license files.
device_evidence: Chromium browser automation is recorded in tests/e2e/sokoban.spec.ts after implementation; physical phones, tablets, controllers and Tesla are not verified.
